detail.command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '=== LOCATION KEYS ==='
if grep -n 'NSLocation' ios/Delete2/Info.plist; then
  echo 'ERROR: unexpected NSLocation key remains in Info.plist'
  exit 1
else
  echo 'OK: no NSLocation keys in Info.plist'
fi
printf '%s\n' '=== PLIST ==='
plutil -lint ios/Delete2/Info.plist
printf '%s\n' '=== TYPECHECK ==='
npm run typecheck
printf '%s\n' '=== JEST ==='
npm test -- --runInBand
printf '%s\n' '=== LINT ==='
npm run lint
printf '%s\n' '=== IOS PRODUCTION BUNDLE ==='
BUNDLE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$BUNDLE_DIR"' EXIT
npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output "$BUNDLE_DIR/main.jsbundle" --assets-dest "$BUNDLE_DIR/assets"
test -s "$BUNDLE_DIR/main.jsbundle"
echo 'OK: production iOS bundle generated'
